ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Visualizing and Navigation Knowledge Networks. Prerequisites: Admission to the course is by permission of the instructor. Eligible students should demonstrate familiarity with one or more of the following: basic network analysis, programming methodoligies, graphic design, human perception and cognition, statistics, computer vision, computer speech analysis, computer graphics, and human computer interaction. Can be taken for 3 hours for undergrads and 4 hours for graduates.
